question: Does the R5 phase-anchored exact-support observable preserve nine-entity alias abstraction when each of three equivalent raw surface families receives an independent finite sample from the same sixteen-context distribution?
hypothesis: The R5 phase anchor resolves exhaustive structural collisions but does not remove finite-sampling variance: at sixty-four independent observations per surface, at least one entity's three aliases will split into different exact-support classes. An exhaustive R5 replication and a matched-sample anchored control must each retain exactly nine correct three-member classes with zero cross-entity collisions.

prior_evidence.observation: Exhaustive phase-anchored support induced exactly nine correct three-member alias classes with zero cross-entity collisions, while the unanchored R4 control retained eight classes and one collision pair.

scope_statement: This experiment changes exactly one R5 dimension: exhaustive enumeration is replaced by the frozen R2/R3 sixty-four-draw matched and independent samplers. Motifs, sixteen contexts, phase coordinate, exact support equality, entity/family cardinalities, representation capacity, and evaluator-only semantic audit remain fixed. It does not introduce a repair learner, task model, approximate match, or language-capability claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, or live-interface authority

arms_and_inputs.exhaustive_r5_replication_control: The exact R5 anchored bridge: every context_index 0..15 appears once for each of nine entities and three families.
arms_and_inputs.matched_sample_anchored_control: For each entity, all three families use the same frozen sixty-four-step R2 sample sequence; signatures are exact supports of five-byte tuples [160 + context_index, prefix0, prefix1, suffix0, suffix1].
arms_and_inputs.independent_sample_anchored_arm: For each entity and family, use the frozen R2 family-specific sixty-four-step sample sequence; signatures use the same exact five-byte anchored support.
arms_and_inputs.matched_seed: 0x243f6a88 XOR ((entity+1)*1009); identical sequence for all families of an entity
arms_and_inputs.independent_seed: 0x243f6a88 XOR ((entity+1)*1009) XOR ((family+1)*0x9e3779b9); distinct deterministic sequence per family
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Deterministic support/class cardinality and evaluator-only entity-membership audit; no task model is trained.

representation_and_measurement.surface_selection: The same twenty-seven raw four-byte motifs selected from the frozen R2 matched bridge, occurrence count descending then lexicographic raw key.
representation_and_measurement.signature: Complete sorted set of observed five-byte anchored context tuples; count magnitudes are discarded and equality is exact.
representation_and_measurement.identifiability_audit: For each arm, count induced classes, three-member classes, correct same-entity alias triplets, split entity triplets, and unordered distinct-entity pairs whose surfaces share a class.
representation_and_measurement.sampling_audit: For sampled arms, count distinct contexts per surface and the maximum symmetric-difference cardinality between same-entity family supports.
representation_and_measurement.semantic_scoring: Entity and family identity enter only after class induction for the audit.

controls: The exhaustive R5 control must reproduce 432 records, sixteen distinct contexts and anchors per surface, nine correct three-member classes, and zero cross-entity collisions.
The matched sampled control must use one sequence per entity across families and produce nine correct three-member classes, zero split entity triplets, and zero cross-entity collisions.
The independent arm differs from the matched arm only in the frozen family-specific sampler seed.
All arms use the same selected motifs, context formulas, phase coordinate, exact support representation, class inducer, and evaluator.
Class induction receives no family label, entity label, semantic label, alias dictionary, tokenizer, task transition, external model, approximate matching, distance threshold, or oracle correction.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The frozen R5 probe reproduces its exact anchored exhaustive cardinalities and class/collision result before any R6 scientific output is emitted.
The exhaustive, matched, and independent bridges have exactly the frozen record cardinalities; every sampled surface has exactly sixty-four observations.
Sampled context indices and seeds are byte-identical to R2/R3, and the five-byte representation is byte-identical to R5.
Independent same-entity empirical supports differ for at least one family pair.
Entity and family identity are unavailable to induction and enter only the post-induction audit.
All 36 unordered entity pairs are audited exactly once per arm.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No task training, tokenizer, external model, network call, capacity growth, approximate matching, threshold change, or adaptive evaluation occurs.

classification_rules.finite_sampling_fragility_supported: Validity and both controls pass; independent same-entity supports differ and at least one entity triplet splits into different exact-support classes.
classification_rules.finite_sampling_invariance_supported: Validity and both controls pass; independent support induces exactly nine correct three-member classes, zero split entity triplets, and zero cross-entity collision pairs.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and both controls pass, but independent results satisfy neither supported rule.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: The exhaustive R5 replication or matched-sample anchored control fails any frozen exact threshold.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the frozen matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, sampling, representation, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on parent, North Star, R5 replication, bridge cardinality, construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R6 output begins, complete all three arms and all three 36-pair audits unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not alter samples, seeds, formulas, coordinates, representation, controls, metrics, thresholds, budgets, capacities, or classification after observing R6 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No input formula, phase coordinate, sample count, seed, representation rule, audit, control, metric, threshold, budget, capacity, or interpretation may change after primary R6 output.
